author: The Current
description:
Marcus Mumford shares his memories of being in Prince's hometown on April 21, 2016
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Marcus Mumford of Mumford & Sons remembers having a concert in St. Paul, Minnesota, on Thursday, April 21, 2016 — the day that Prince died. "Being in his hometown on the day he passed," Mumford recalls, "for the people in the room that night, it felt like we had a responsibility to mark it and respect it."

Watch more of what Marcus Mumford has to say in his interview with The Current's Zach McCormick, above.

author: The Current
description:
Music journalist Andrea Swensson shares her story about the day Prince died
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Music journalist Andrea Swensson recalls reporting from Paisley Park on April 21, 2016, the day that Prince died. "It was like standing in the middle of a tornado," Swensson tells The Current's Reed Fischer, "but I felt very calm and focused."
